notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i laikim pronoun bilong king bilong Shomron

notes.subject: hap diwai i bruk
notes.rationale: קצף: 'hap diwai i bruk / fom' (KJV 'foam') o 'pait strong'; 'fom' i tsimpi, 'hap diwai' i klostu long liklik mak bilongקצף

notes.subject: Shomron i lus pinis
notes.rationale: נדמה i no gathet — 'Shomron em yet i dai olsem king bilong en' (YLT) o 'ol i rausim king bilong Shomron'

translation: Shomron i lus pinis, king bilong ⟨em⟩, olsem hap diwai i bruk i flout long pes bilong wara.
